details.eligibility: Graduation (Bachelor's degree) from a recognised university. Age limit as per CEN notification - verify on rrbapply.gov.in.
details.pattern: CBT 1: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. CBT 2: 120 questions. Negative marking 1/3 per wrong answer. Then Typing Skill Test / CBAT for applicable posts, Document Verification and Medical Examination.
details.syllabus: Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness (CBT 1 and CBT 2).
details.important_dates: CEN 06/2024: CBT 1 held 5-24 Jun 2025; CBT 2 held 13 Oct 2025.

notes: ROUND 3 — 2026-11-21. Years are recorded by HELD date (round 1 used CEN year, so its June/Oct 2025-held papers are labelled 2024 there — do not duplicate). Graduate CBT 1 (CEN 05/2024) was held 5-24 Jun 2025; CBT 2 was held 13 Oct 2025 and is covered by the round-1 Testbook hub. No NTPC exam was held in 2023 or 2024 (Adda247). New 2026 cycle: Graduate CBT 1 held 16-27 Mar 2026. CareerPower's page also lists 2026 CBT 2 shift-wise tables (seen in crawl); the CBT 2 2026 dates were not independently confirmed from the crawl excerpt, so treat that entry as hub-listed only. No official paper PDFs exist: RRB publishes only answer keys/response sheets per CEN on rrbapply.gov.in and regional portals.
